Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed that the official BBC script for "Heaven Sent" would be available as a downloadable PDF on the BBC Writersroom website. This assumption led to a series of futile attempts by the WebSurfer to access a non-existent or inaccessible file. The error was a failure to verify the availability of the primary source before committing the entire workflow to retrieving it, resulting in a prolonged loop of failed navigation attempts and unnecessary code execution.
